mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuation, increasing present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when both HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 440000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals supply constraints that reduce economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a strong economy that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when PAYEMS > 138000 and UNRATE < 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market recovery (HOUST > 1000) signals increased consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when HOUST > 1000.
